jobs.description:
Do you have experience in home cleaning and want to work within a company that gives the opportunity to grow and develop? Or are you in the beginning of your career and want to work in a company that offers high quality training and a safe employment? Apply to become one of our amazing home cleaners!
Freska - More than just a cleaning company 💙
Freska is one of the fastest growing companies with one goal in mind; to make Freska the best, most recommended workplace for service workers in Europe. In fact, our values; People first, Growth and Responsibility symbolize ways that we are working to make Freska a better workplace. Your day to day work, future goals and ambitions matter to us. Among other things we have developed a career path for our home cleaners as well as a support system to try to make everyday work life run as smoothly as possible. No matter if this is a job for you who wants to advance in your career, a safe employment or even start your first job here in Sweden, we are here for you!
We have come a long way to reach our goal and are always striving to find ways to improve. So far we have the possibility to offer our employees:
Contract with guaranteed hours from the start!
Possibility of bonus
Collective agreement
Health benefits
Paid travel time between customers
Career opportunities
Training and coaching in home cleaning
A tight-knit team with a team leader to support you in the daily work
Immediate support from the office during your working day
Unlimited amount of coffee and chats in the office
Steady schedule that locks seven days prior
Overtime compensated at 228 kr/hour, with monthly payouts and no time bank! 

About the job 👇
You will work in our customers most beloved place - their home. A home cleaning includes dusting, vacuuming and mopping. It is of great advantage if you have a sense of details. Your primary work tool will be our Freska Pro app where you will be able to see your schedule, customer information and general information about Freska.
With that being said, being a home cleaner also comes with some responsibility, therefore we are looking for someone who:
Speaks Swedish or English
Can work flexibly between our working hours 08.00-17.00.
Has a valid working permit
Has experience in cleaning, advantage but no requirement

So where do we go from here?
1. Apply!
2.Get an invite to an interview
3. Show us your cleaning skills
4. You’re hired!
5. Watch our digital onboarding
6. Come to the office for an onboarding
7. Go for training with your team leader
8. Start working, good luck!
Apply now!

Technical Lead – Active Chassis Systems
At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers.
We are currently looking for a Embedded Software Engineer to join a highly innovative team developing next-generation Active Chassis and Suspension Systems for future vehicle platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full software stack, developing advanced control functions that enhance vehicle dynamics, comfort, and driving performance.
About the Assignment
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing software for advanced suspension systems. The team works across application software, middleware, control algorithms, and supporting toolchains to deliver cutting-edge active chassis functionality. You will collaborate closely with software developers, system engineers, safety engineers, and test engineers, contributing throughout the software development lifecycle from concept to validation.
Main Responsibilities
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will:
Develop application software in C++ and middleware software in C for active chassis and suspension systems.

Contribute to software development for both dedicated ECUs and centralized vehicle computing platforms.

Collaborate with system, safety, and test engineers in a cross-functional environment.

Support integration, testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities.

Participate in the development of control algorithms and supporting toolchains.

Contribute to software quality, performance, and safety throughout the development process.

Drive technical improvements and continuous development of products and processes.

Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in C++ (C++11/C++14) and/or C (C90/C99) development.

Minimum 5 years of experience in real-time embedded software development.

Experience within the automotive industry.

Experience working with AUTOSAR.

Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including: CAN, Automotive Ethernet, Experience with UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services).

Experience using Vector tools such as: CANoe, CANalyzer, vTESTstudio

Knowledge of low-level embedded protocols: SPI, UART, PWM, DIO, PSI5

Experience with HIL systems and real-time simulation environments.

Knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety implementation.

Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity standards.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on, then we would love to hear from you.
Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world.
Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date, it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.

Who we are 
We've completed over 40 million deliveries, serving millions of consumers and some of the largest e-commerce retailers in the Nordics. As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue.
And we're just getting started. With a proven platform, growing market share and significant opportunities ahead, we're entering our next phase of growth.
We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it.
 About the role
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in logistics and operations while taking on increasing responsibility in a fast-growing company.
As a Partner Coordinator at Airmee, you’ll play a role in ensuring our delivery network runs smoothly and efficiently. You will be the go-to contact for selected last mile and linehaul carriers, making sure they receive the support, information, and coordination needed to deliver great service. You’ll be a part of our Carrier Management team and work closely with other Partner coordinators and the Partnership Manager to support both daily operations and planning activities.
Key responsibilities:

Act as the point of contact for a selection of our last mile and linehaul carriers, ensuring they receive timely support and information

Monitor daily performance and service quality using dashboards and KPIs, and share insights with both carriers and internal teams

Collaborate with Dispatch and other teams to quickly resolve issues related to delays, damages, or customer complaints

Assist in capacity planning by aligning vehicle supply with both short-term fluctuations and long-term forecasts

Ensure scheduling and shift templates are accurate and up to date, and help fill gaps through close coordination with carrier partners

Support the onboarding of new carriers and ensure compliance with Airmee’s standards, Code of Conduct, and operational routines

Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, operational environment and enjoys working collaboratively to solve problems and keep things running smoothly.

You’re detail-oriented and structured, but flexible enough to adapt when plans change.

You have a natural sense of ownership and take initiative to improve day-to-day operations.

With communication skills, you build trust with both internal teams and external partners.

Being data-minded, you use insights to guide decisions and drive performance forward.

Requirements:
Experience in logistics, customer support, operations or similar.

Fluency in Swedish or English.

Good Excel skills

Are You Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Submit your application today!
 
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

DevSecOps Consultant
Who are we?
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.
Job description
Join Amaris Consulting as a DevSecOps Consultant in Gothenburg and contribute to a strategic project for one of our clients in the automotive sector. Within a Cyber Security Expert Team, the role focuses on supporting development and platform teams with security expertise, governance, and practical DevSecOps practices across cloud, application, and platform environments.
Your missions
Provide operational security support to development and platform teams on security questions, findings, incidents, and risk assessments.
Support the integration of automated security controls, scanning, and policies into development lifecycles and CI/CD pipelines.
Contribute to secure design and implementation across cloud environments, applications, and container-based platforms.
Assist teams with vulnerability handling, third-party dependency management, and software supply chain security practices.
Coach development and platform teams on practical security measures that support delivery speed and reliability.
Apply established security best practices, benchmarks, and governance standards across technical environments.
Share knowledge within the Cyber Security Expert Team to improve ways of working and common practices.
Contribute to the development of security standards, guidelines, and reusable approaches across the organization.

Your profile
Experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or security engineering within development or platform environments.
Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms and core services, including compute, identity, networking, logging, and monitoring.
Experience with vulnerability management, secure development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and security automation.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.
Knowledge of container orchestration platforms, code scanning, artifact scanning, and dependency governance is a plus.
Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks is a plus.
Academic background in cybersecurity, computer science, software development, information systems, or a related field is appreciated.
English fluent. Swedish is a plus.
Strong analytical and structured mindset, with the ability to work independently in complex technical environments.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

jobs.occupation: IT Support, part-time to a company within circular grocery
jobs.description:
Seeking a flexible and impactful part-time IT role? We are looking for a junior IT Support Specialist to join a forward-thinking circular grocery company in Stockholm. In this role, you will balance first-line helpdesk support with daily IT security tasks—making it an ideal fit alongside your studies or other commitments. Apply today - selection is ongoing.
About the role
In this role, you will manage daily IT operations and security tasks for our customer. You will support employees with their technical needs, manage cloud platforms, and ensure the organization's technical setup remains secure and aligned with industry standards.
You are offered
This is a flexible, part-time position (50% / 20 hours per week) perfect for students or junior professionals looking to gain hands-on IT experience. It offers a highly adaptable schedule (mornings or afternoons) and a supportive environment to learn and grow.
Work tasks
A dual-focus role handling first-line helpdesk support and essential IT security tasks to keep daily office operations running securely and smoothly.
Provide on-site and remote IT support to employees for accounts and hardware.  
Administer and support devices using Microsoft Intune.  
Manage users, groups, and access in Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace.  
Perform basic network troubleshooting on office infrastructure, including Wi-Fi and printers.  
Support security operations, including patch management and triaging Microsoft Defender alerts.  
Manage and troubleshoot integrations such as single sign-on (SSO).  
Assist the Legal team with GDPR requests and manage password systems like 1Password.

We are looking for
Higher education in IT or a related field of study.
You have another primary occupation of at least 50% (e.g., studies).
Basic knowledge of IT support and network troubleshooting.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and/or Google Workspace.
Professional proficiency in English.

It is meritorious if you have
Previous experince working with IT-support
Basic knowledge of Jira and GDPR processes.
Proficiency in Swedish.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Social
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, you’ll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

Join Midsummer as a Production Operator at our production facility in Järfälla. You'll work with the manufacturing of our lightweight and flexible solar panels, supporting efficient production and consistent product quality.
This is a role for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in quality and is interested in technology and manufacturing. You'll work closely with your colleagues in production and contribute to stable processes and daily operations.
Please note that we are primarily recruiting for our evening shift.

What you'll be doing
As we rotate between different workstations and production steps, your tasks may vary over time. Depending on your workstation, the role may include:

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production processes

Manufacturing and assembling solar cells and solar panels throughout different stages of production

Working with small components that require precision and attention to detail

Performing quality checks and documenting production results

Monitoring processes and reporting deviations

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

What we're looking for
An interest in technology and the ability to understand manufacturing processes

The ability to read, understand and follow technical instructions and work procedures

A structured and quality-focused way of working

Fluency in English, both written and spoken

The ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Previous experience from industrial production, assembly work, manufacturing environments or other roles involving precision and quality control is considered advantageous.
Technical, industrial or scientific education is also considered advantageous.

Who you are
You're reliable, responsible and quality conscious. You work in a structured manner, follow established procedures and take ownership of your work.
You have a safety-focused mindset and understand the importance of following routines and maintaining high quality standards. At the same time, you're a team player with good collaboration skills, adaptable to changing priorities and interested in technology and production.
Most importantly, you're motivated to learn, contribute and grow as part of the production team.

About Midsummer
Midsummer is a Swedish solar energy company that develops and manufactures lightweight, flexible solar cells with a carbon footprint approximately 90% lower than traditional solar panels. We control the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished products.
In addition to our own production, Midsummer develops and supplies complete manufacturing systems for flexible thin-film solar cells to customers around the world.
By joining Midsummer, you'll become part of a team contributing to the production of solar technology while working in an international and collaborative environment.

Interested?
We review applications continuously, so don't hesitate to submit your application.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Hitachi Energy is seeking a proactive and organized Business Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to various departments and leadership.
This role is crucial for ensuring the smooth daily functioning of business operations and contributing to overall organizational efficiency.
Job Responsibilities
Coordinate and facilitate internal and external meetings, including preparing agendas, taking minutes, and distributing materials.
Act as a liaison between departments, internal stakeholders, and external partners, maintaining clear and professional communication.
Support project management activities, including tracking deadlines, preparing updates, and organizing resources.
Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
Order and manage office supplies and equipment, ensuring adequate stock levels.
Manage and maintain calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate complex travel arrangements for executives and teams.
Prepare and edit reports and documents, ensuring accuracy and professional presentation.
Assist with budget tracking, expense reporting, and processing invoices.
Perform general administrative duties as required to support business operations.

Job Qualifications
Associate's degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Science, or a related field; Bachelor's degree preferred.
2+ years of experience in an administrative or business support role, preferably within a large corporate environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and experience with collaboration tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with integrity.
Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is a plus.

More About Us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 SEK/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today.
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Linnea Gustavsson, linnea.gustavsson@hitachienergy.com.

Your New Role
We are looking for an AP Coordinator to join an international Finance team in Stockholm. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at an early stage of their finance career to develop their skills within Accounts Payable while contributing to an important transformation project.
In this role, you will manage supplier invoices across the EMEA region, ensuring accurate processing, correct VAT treatment and compliance with local requirements. You will investigate invoice discrepancies, handle PO matching and non-PO invoices, and act as a point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders.
You will also play an important role in bringing outsourced AP activities in-house and supporting the implementation of a new AI-powered invoice automation solution. This includes conducting user acceptance testing (UAT), validating supplier data, monitoring automation results and documenting improved processes.
You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Tax, IT and business operations in an international and collaborative environment.
Company Presentation
You will join a global organization with an international working environment, where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are key priorities.
Good to Know
Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters, with the possibility of permanent employment Working model: Hybrid, 3–4 days per week at the Stockholm office Salary: According to agreement Start date: ASAP

A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.

Basic knowledge of accounting and Accounts Payable, preferably with around one year of relevant experience. Recent graduates are welcome to apply.

An understanding of invoice processing, financial accuracy and compliance.

Excellent written and spoken English.

A structured, detail-oriented and proactive approach, with strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Experience with NetSuite, Coupa, Kyriba or similar ERP systems, as well as VAT and automation, is considered an advantage.

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description:Are you a disciplined person with good leadership qualities and would you like to work worldwide with the installation and service operations we have within NKT?
  
 Then you should apply for this position.
  
 Lead installation projects on site
 You will have a leading role at site where you will ensure that all project members, subcontractors and our own staff, are aware of their responsibility and that they have the resources, authority and influence to carry out the tasks efficiently and safely. One of our core values within NKT is Safety First and you will ensure that the work follows our internal HSE procedures but also that our installation operations are conducted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Frequent travelling will be required. The role is based in Sweden/Karlskrona.
  
 As a Site Manager for our installation-projects you will be responsible for keeping the delegated budget and schedule. You will work with installation activities – for example planning, preparation and execution of cable jointing, cable terminations, installation at platforms for offshore windfarms, Interconnectors, oil & gas and where appropriate cable testing depending on the given delegation.
 You will also need to handle interface items with other contractors and clients therefore your communicative skills are highly important.
  
 Result oriented and structured communicator.
 We are looking for a communicative person as you will maintain the contacts with our clients, subcontractors and suppliers but also your colleagues.Ideally you have long experience in installation and operations onshore/offshore and experience from project management in international context. To thrive in this role you should be disciplined, have a good modern leadership with motivation skills as well as being a service-minded person.
  
 Key parts of your responsibilities are:
 •    Interpret and carry out technical, commercial, and legal customer requirements.•    Support the tender sales manager and other departments.
 •    Ensure NKT quality standards are applied on site
 •    In a structured way document, manage and track the progress of the project from planning to execution and closure.
  
 Additionally, your CV comprises:
 •    Bachelor’s degree either within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience from working•    Very good English language skills, spoken and written
 •    Experienced user of MS Office
 •    Experience of site installation works.
 •    Experience of work-traveling.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Hospitality Career?
Do you have experience in housekeeping and a passion for leading people? Are you looking for a workplace where your leadership skills are valued, your development is supported, and your efforts truly make a difference?
At OMNILS GROUP AB, we're not just cleaning hotel rooms, we're creating exceptional guest experiences. We are now looking for an energetic and motivated Housekeeping Team Leader to join our growing team in Stockholm.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy inspiring others, and want to be part of a company with ambitious growth plans, we'd love to hear from you!
Why Join OMNILS GROUP?
OMNILS GROUP is one of Sweden's growing hospitality service providers, specializing in housekeeping and facility services for hotels and Real Estates
Approximately 200,000 hotel rooms are served annually
Around 200 employees across Sweden
ISO-certified in 14001& 9001
Collective agreement for secure employment conditions in Visita, Almega.
Pension and insurance according to collective agreements

 We believe our success comes from our people. That's why we invest in our employees' growth, well-being, and future.
Our Core Values
Commitment
Happiness

As a Housekeeping Team Leader, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while inspiring and developing your team.
This is more than a supervisory role. It's an opportunity to build leadership experience, influence daily operations, and contribute to the success of some of Sweden's leading hotels.
You will act as the bridge between hotel management, housekeeping staff, and OMNILS leadership while helping maintain exceptional quality and guest satisfaction.
What You'll Do:
Lead, coach, and inspire your housekeeping team
Plan daily operations and allocate responsibilities efficiently
Ensure exceptional cleaning quality and service standards
Conduct quality inspections and provide feedback
Support employee development and training
Collaborate closely with hotel management and reception teams
Monitor schedules, attendance, and reporting
Manage housekeeping supplies and inventory
Step into operations when needed and lead by example
Create a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment

Who You Are:
We're looking for someone who is positive, reliable, flexible and motivated by helping others succeed.
Requirements:
At least 1-2 years of housekeeping experience within hotels
Previous experience leading or supervising a team
Strong communication and people skills
Excellent organization and problem-solving abilities
Detail-oriented with a passion for quality
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Swedish and/or English
Driving license is an advantage
Valid work permit in Sweden or Swedish citizenship

Career Growth
We believe in promoting from within. High-performing Team Leaders can develop into Supervisors, Operations Coordinators, Quality Controllers, and other leadership positions as the company grows.

Leadership training

Ongoing coaching and support

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years. In this role, you will transform shopper insights into engaging retail concepts that strengthen the consumer experience and drive commercial growth.
 
Impact You’ll Make
